english: No, I do not have time.

igbo: Mba, achọghị m ihe ọ bụla.
english: No, I do not need anything.
I do not know that place.
The book is on the table.
I am looking for my friend.

igbo: Ọ dị m ka ike gwụrụ m.
Ezinụlọ m dị mkpa nye m.
english: My family is important to me.

igbo: Ana m ahụ ezinụlọ m n'anya.
Ọtụtụ ihe ka anyị nwere ike ime.
english: There are many things we can do.
